_meta.dataSource: fifacm.com FC 26 live database (latest update 23 Jun 2026) — attributes, positions, roles+/++, PlayStyles/PlayStyles+
_meta.ovrLaunchSource: EA official FC 26 ratings reveal (Sept 2025) via sportskeeda.com / beebom.com articles
_meta.real2627Source: fcbarcelona.com first-team squad page + 2026/27 jersey numbers news (02 Sep 2026) + en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026–27_FC_Barcelona_season
_meta.faceFormula: Face stats computed from detailed attributes with standard weights (verified against EA ratings page): PAC=.45Acc+.55Spr, SHO, PAS, DRI(approx.), DEF, PHY
notes: Work rates are not used: since FC 25 they are replaced by Roles (FC IQ); fifacm shows Med/Med for everyone.
Ages are database ages (at game data date), not real current ages.
OVR is stored for display only — the danger rating NEVER uses OVR.
